description: dimabot cron host (dima-cron): the frozen TypeScript cron supervisor and its TypeScript workers at 0c71108e in image dimabot-ref:0c71108e, production command and variable names with test values only; the preload is inherited by every worker process through NODE_OPTIONS. The image has no native Rust binaries, so node/cron_index_stub.sh stands in for /usr/local/bin/cron_index (the seven native workers' reference is the Rust in dima-rust/src at 0c71108e). No listening port: ready when the domain-events dispatcher worker has connected to MongoDB; the start-up settle then waits until the other workers' index builds and locks are done (about 1.5 GiB for the 18 worker processes). Candidate: not ported yet.

mock.startup_reason: Start-up traffic (the AST catalog embedded into Qdrant, the docs site fetched for the assistant, OTLP logs) is the same for every scenario and large; it is compared by its own scenario, not stored in each capture.
mock.compare_reason: posthog-node sends its batches on its own 10 s timer, so whether the start-up $identify batch (or any event's) lands inside a scenario depends on timing. A scenario that checks analytics events sets compare.calls.posthog to multiset and waits for the batch with wait_call.

candidate.unavailable: The Rust binary (dima-cron) does not exist yet: record only.
